_meta.about: Epidemic Sound downloads for "What If Real Life Had a SETTINGS MENU?" (metadata only; audio stays in the scratch raw/ folder).
_meta.loudness: BS.1770-4 K-weighted: lufs_i gated integrated (ungated for files <0.4 s); lufs_m_max max 400 ms momentary; lufs_200_max max 200 ms window; true peak 4x oversampled.
_meta.onset_peak_tail: 5 ms RMS envelope, 2.5 ms hop. first_onset_s = first frame above max(floor+15, peak-40) dB; main_peak_s = loudest 5 ms; tail_s = main peak to last frame above max(floor+3, peak-60) dB.
_meta.takes: gate on/off thresholds (on = max(floor+min(15, range/2), peak-40), off = max(floor+min(6, range/4), peak-52)), gaps <70 ms merged, split where a re-attack rises >=12 dB in 20 ms to within 8 dB of the previous hit (and within 10 dB of the loudest hit so far in the region) after a dip of >=12 dB that reaches >=24 dB under that loudest hit (parts >=30 ms). t1 = gate off; t1_tail = tail followed down to max(floor+3, take peak-60) dB (never into the next take). glide = dominant frequency start/mid/end over the take (shape up/down/flat/arch/dip). Max 64 takes listed (takes_truncated).
_meta.dropouts: digital-silence runs (>=10 ms, |x|<=1e-6) inside a file: avoid these ranges in beds.
_meta.classes: music | one_shot | multi_take | bed (ambience/loop/texture: segmentation listed but use a time range)

zips.sfx_a_ui: ES_User Interface, Click, UI Buttons, Confirm, Menu - Epidemic Sound (1).zip (nested in sfx_a)

_meta.durations: duration_s / n_samples = ffmpeg gapless decode (encoder delay and padding removed); duration_probe_s = MP3 header duration, 24-47 ms longer. All times in these JSON files use the decoded clock: decode with lib.decode / load_sfx / load_music.
_meta.duplicates: duplicate_of marks byte-identical files (two "(1)" copies in sfx_b).
_meta.format: All 201 files are MP3 at 48 kHz (33 mono, the rest stereo); no stems were included with the music.
